name: autonomous-video-production
author: Laufer108
project: Laufer108 AI-native film: an instruction for AI agents, published as a video
purpose: Autonomous long-form narrated video production with verification at every stage

reference_implementation.film: Laufer108 review of 239 Polish AI videos, version 2

tested_environment.yt_dlp: 2026.7.4 (public metadata and captions; the ingestion script is not published)
tested_environment.tts_engine: Scrimba Explain via MCP endpoint https://scrimba.com/explain/pr/mcp (pl-PL, en-US voices)

operator_answers: target channel id and OAuth token file
input_contract.narration_timing: schemas/cues.schema.json: one audio file per module plus {duration, lines:[{t, text}]}

output_contract: final MP4 (H.264 yuv420p limited range, AAC 48 kHz)
private YouTube video verified by read-back

caption_assertions: no phonetic spelling outside quotation marks

whisper.basis: Whisper text vs DISPLAY text, lowercase words, digits for numbers (reference/tools/asr_gate_en.py)
whisper.on_fail: fix the display text or re-record; never lower the threshold

delivery.captions: inside the film, no phonetic spellings outside quotation marks
delivery.frame_review: 1 frame per minute + 1 frame per detector interval, inspected
delivery.upload: private; channel id matched before upload; read back with videos.list and captions.list

runtime_constraint.reason: operator: downstream analytics processes videos under 40 minutes (operator decision, not verified by the agent)

source_authority: artifacts on disk > canon file > earlier prompts > chat; unverifiable facts are marked unverified
known_limitations: Tested on one Windows machine only.
Narration captured from browser playback because download requires a login and claim; compliance with the provider's terms is unverified and is the operator's decision.
No fallback TTS engine was tested. If narration capture breaks, the agent stops and reports; the operator decides on another engine.
Remotion pixel-format setting did not change JPEG-based full-range output; the final ffmpeg pass converts it.
Whisper similarity is a coarse gate: digits vs numerals count as differences; homophones (Claude/clawed) pass by ear but not by spelling.

reference/ holds two code references: the version-two excerpt (does not build) and film2/, the complete code of the AI-native film (built and rendered; its narration, cues, generated shots and outro are not published).
